name: Amara Okonkwo
bio: Runs chapter strategy and the exec board. Spent last summer in investment banking and came back convinced the recruiting process is far more learnable than it looks from the outside.
funFacts: Has read the same book about airlines four times.
Can name every campus coffee cart by walking distance.
Once pitched a stock to a room of 200 people with no slides.

name: Diego Márquez
bio: Owns everything member-facing: pledge education, big-little pairings, and the retreat that somehow gets bigger every year.
funFacts: Maintains a spreadsheet ranking 60+ taco shops in San Diego County.
Learned to code the week before a hackathon and placed second.
Sleeps exactly six hours and insists this is fine.

name: Priya Raghunathan
bio: Handles firm relationships, the speaker series, and the winter trek. If a recruiter knows the chapter by name, that is usually why.
funFacts: Cold-emailed 90 firms in one quarter and heard back from 31.
Speaks four languages, three of them badly by her own account.
Has never once lost an argument about tipping.

name: Jonah Feldman
bio: Keeps the books and runs the student-managed fund. Will explain the difference between IRR and MOIC to anyone who stands still long enough.
funFacts: Beat the chapter's S&P benchmark two quarters running, then lost to it badly.
Bakes sourdough on a strict Sunday schedule.
Rated 1900 online, 1400 over the board, and bitter about the gap.

name: Mei-Lin Chow
bio: Designs the quarterly curriculum — résumé clinics, mock interviews, case workshops — and personally sits in on more practice rounds than anyone.
funFacts: Has conducted over 200 mock interviews.
Threw 40 mugs last quarter and gave away 39.
Keeps a running list of the worst interview questions ever asked.

name: Tobias Almeida
bio: Runs the brand, the socials, and the rush campaign. Rebuilt the chapter's visual identity over one winter break.
funFacts: Grew the chapter Instagram from 400 to 5,000 in two quarters.
Owns more records than shirts.
Names every design file after a song.

name: Nia Bennett
bio: Joined in the fall class and immediately signed up for two consulting projects at once.
funFacts: Performed at a campus open mic three days after moving in.
Has never paid full price for a blazer.
Reads two books at a time, one fiction and one not.

name: Hiro Tanaka
bio: Builds the internal tooling nobody asked for and everybody now depends on, including the chapter's attendance dashboard.
funFacts: Surfs before 7am class more often than not.
Built the chapter's attendance dashboard in a weekend.
Has soldered three keyboards and used one.

name: Camila Reyes
bio: Splits time between the consulting practice and an internship at a cross-border logistics firm.
funFacts: Commuted across the border for two years of high school.
Teaches a beginner salsa class on Sundays.
Makes mole from scratch, which takes her most of a Saturday.

name: Elias Duarte
bio: Came in wanting to do real estate private equity and has not wavered once since the first info session.
funFacts: Can estimate a building's floor count from a photo, usually correctly.
Climbs V6 and claims V7 on a good day.
Has toured 40 buildings downtown for fun.

name: Rania Haddad
bio: Leads the pro-bono engagement with a South Bay health nonprofit and is aiming at healthcare consulting.
funFacts: Ran a vaccine clinic drive that registered 600 people.
Brings knafeh to every chapter potluck.
Translates poetry for fun and refuses to show anyone.

name: Grant Whitaker
bio: Returning summer analyst who now spends most Thursdays running mock interviews for the new class.
funFacts: Has done 60+ mock interviews on the interviewer side.
Skis 30 days a year and has the GPA dip to prove it.
Owns exactly one tie and it has never been retired.

name: Yuki Sato
bio: Product-minded, joined to get closer to the business side of software, and has been shadowing the consulting practice since.
funFacts: Shipped an app that 300 classmates actually used.
Plays piano at the Che Café open mic.
Owns 40 board games and has taught every one to the chapter.

name: Sasha Volkov
bio: Transferred in last year, joined the winter class, and now runs point on the chapter's alumni outreach list.
funFacts: Transferred from community college and says it was the best decision available.
Deadlifts more than anyone will admit to knowing.
Has convinced eleven members to try a cold plunge.
